tools.name: get_page_context
tools.description: Read the current Battery Trader page title, URL, heading, and public catalog discovery links. Use this to understand which product or category the user is viewing.

tools.name: open_catalog_index
tools.description: Open the public LLM catalog index (llms.txt) or the store homepage so an agent can start product discovery.

target.description: llms opens /llms.txt, home opens the storefront, search opens advanced search.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the Battery Trader product catalog by keyword, model, SKU, or device name. Returns matching products and a results page URL.

query.description: Search keywords, product model, or device name.

navigate.description: If true, open the search results page in this browser tab.
